title: TransportState
description: Snapshot of the transport, returned by every transport command and emitted on the 'transport://state' app event when state or position jumps discontinuously. Mirrors Rust struct audio::TransportState.

positionSamples.description: Playhead position in samples at sampleRate, measured from project start (0).

sampleRate.description: Engine sample rate in Hz (e.g. 44100, 48000). All *Samples fields in the IPC surface are in this unit.

tempoBpm.description: Project tempo in beats per minute.

loopEndSamples.description: Loop region end (exclusive), in samples. 0 when no loop region is set.
